description: The dedicated server for full bench runs. Kimina Lean Server runs on the same machine and requires its key. The Lean environment is LEAN_ENV (default base, lean/env/base.toml): a run records its hash, and LEAN_PROJECT_DIR defaults to the environment's project once `harness lean-env build` has built it. The certifier runs lake in the Lean project LEAN_PROJECT_DIR and is unavailable until this profile gives it a sandbox command: this host never runs it unsandboxed (documentation/certifier.md#where-untrusted-code-runs). SageMath runs in its container only. Lean's language server (lean-lsp-mcp, pinned) runs on the project in LEAN_PROJECT_DIR; its searches ask Loogle, LeanSearch, Lean Finder and a premise server over the network. The OEIS, the LMFDB and FindStat are asked over the network, at their public addresses or at OEIS_URL, LMFDB_URL and FINDSTAT_URL. They are optional: `harness health` shows a site that does not answer as a warning and does not fail on it. The Jev backend of decide.ask (documentation/decide.md) sends the states and questions of decisions to a third party, OpenRouter or TypeSafe AI, at the hosts this profile allows, and only when a run asks for it (--decide-backend jev or --decide-site) and JEV_API_KEY and a pinned JEV_MODEL are set; otherwise the run's model decides.
